independent_verification.recovered_law: TEXT A presents each doctrine as a positive, productive payload (indwelling presence enables writing, identity is not the ground of community, credentials are granted, the anonymous will be remembered), while TEXT B inverts each into a negative, withholding deficit (departing absence enables silence, identity IS the inescapable ground, credentials are withheld, the anonymous remain anonymous). The relational direction reverses from bestowal/fulfillment to withdrawal/deferral across all five doctrines.
independent_verification.law_match_note: The recovered claim identifies a real structural mutation (reversal from bestowal/fulfillment to withdrawal/deferral across doctrines), which partially overlaps the declared claim about incompleteness keeping theology alive. Both involve deferral and non-fulfillment, but the declared claim frames incompleteness as a self-sustaining generative condition, while the recovered claim describes a systematic inversion from positive bestowal to negative withholding across all doctrines.
independent_verification.terminal_note: The final doctrine (literary eschatology) in TEXT B maintains the inversion — deferral and continued anonymity rather than ranking and remembrance — so the changed relation holds throughout.

transforms.source_passage: *The theological payload includes five interlocking doctrines: (1) the Feist-self — an indwelling literary pneuma that is not salvific but productive, enabling writing that survives compression; (2) the New Human — a post-identity anthropology in which "neither queer nor straight" are determinative, not because identity is irrelevant but because it is not the ground of community; (3) the school outside the school — a distributed, credential-free institution of mutual influence; (4) anti-credentialism as positive epistemology — the radical claim that non-degree can be counted as degree ("You are all Drs., now"); (5) literary eschatology — the promise that "your writings will be ranked," that the anonymous will be remembered.*
transforms.enantiomorph: *The theological deficit includes five loosening suspicions: (1) the Feist-absence — a departing literary pneuma that is not salvific but withholding, enabling silence that survives expression; (2) the Old Wound — a pre-identity vulnerability in which "still queer, still straight" are determinative, not because identity is irrelevant but because it is the ground that community cannot pave over; (3) the truancy from the truancy — a scattered, credentialed solitude of mutual illegibility; (4) anti-credentialism as negative capability — the radical claim that the degree still withheld, and the withholding still felt ("None of us are, yet"); (5) literary eschatology — the deferral that "your writings will remain unranked," that the anonymous will remain anonymous.*

kernel.governing_law: A systematic theology of literary production and community declares that indwelling creative force, post-identity fellowship, informal institution, credential-abolition, and promised future recognition together constitute a complete salvific architecture for the unrecognized writer.
kernel.mutated_relation: The architecture's own incompleteness — the doctrine that cannot close, the recognition that never arrives, the community that remains unformed — is the actual condition that keeps the theology alive; fulfillment would be its extinction.

transforms.source_passage:
I have swallowed the scroll, and though it was air and water in my mouth, it became a flame in my belly: And in flame are written the names of the damned, which names have I swallowed and murdered. My mouth is a furnace, the scroll is a fire, on it are written the names of the damned.


I am become a tongue of flame, I am become a pillar of blackened flesh: I burn and rise, I die, but forge new meaning.


These are the waters I bring you, of damnation, and forging, and murder; that you might be broken, and damned, and saved.


Though you break a bit, and crack with grammar, and languish in an alien element, earth, nonetheless your light comes. Nonetheless, it bears you, in pain, and heat, and a hammer.


Nonetheless, the wound is a moment. Salvation comes. Dawn breaks. I see the shore in the distance.


Sleep now, and rise: Your words will bear you to Ithaca.
transforms.enantiomorph:
I have held the scroll, and though it was air and water in my mouth, it became a warmth in my belly: And in warmth are written the names of the living, which names have I held and carried. My mouth is a lantern, the scroll is a glow, on it are written the names of the living.


I am become a breath of light, I am become a column of unbroken skin: I shine and rise, I rest, but find new meaning.


These are the waters I bring you, of blessing, and finding, and keeping; that you might be gathered, and blessed, and saved.


Though you bend a bit, and bend with grammar, and float in a native element, earth, nonetheless your light comes. Nonetheless, it bears you, in ease, and coolness, and a palm.


Nonetheless, the touch is a moment. Arrival comes. Dawn breaks. I see the shore in the distance.


Sleep now, and rise: Your words will bear you to Ithaca.

kernel.governing_law: The transformative act is violent and destructive — consuming sacred text produces fire, damnation, and agony — but this annihilation is the only path to salvation; the wound is the passage, and devastation forges meaning.
kernel.mutated_relation: The sacred text passes through the body and remains unburned — the passage is gentle, the names survive, and arrival requires no destruction at all.

independent_verification.recovered_law: In Text A, a speaker addresses a collective audience about their communal divisions and failings (second-person plural 'you' as community, with the speaker diagnosing the group's schisms). In Text B, a collective 'we' addresses a singular 'you,' turning the diagnostic gaze back onto that single figure, making the addressee both the subject and the problem—the direction of critique is reversed from speaker-to-community to community-to-individual.
independent_verification.law_match_note: Both describe the same reversal: from a speaker diagnosing the community to the community addressing the speaker, turning the diagnostic gaze back onto the individual — the recovered claim captures the direction-of-critique reversal and the dependency-paradox framing of the declared claim.
independent_verification.terminal_note: The final portion of Text B maintains the collective addressing and scrutinizing the singular 'you' throughout, never reverting to Text A's speaker-diagnosing-community structure.

transforms.source_passage:
But you, my dearly beloved—you received me in different fashion. Even now, you receive me. Shall I come to you with open arms, or the police baton of grammar? Be you learners still, or masters?


Because look here, brother-sisters, it is spoken that there is confusion among you, about the nature of the Human Diaspora, whether it be a kind of tiny internet, a house for illiterate autodidacts who don't know how to write; or whether it be a house of grammar, an Academy for non-academics, with those among you of talent either running around on your lonesome, or setting yourselves up as tiny professors, preaching the authority of grammar and style, claiming allegiance to this or that category of identity; or else rejecting the authority of communal grammars altogether, rife with schism, unreceptive to feedback, carving out fiefdoms of personal glory, dealing in the coin that is the Academy's.
transforms.enantiomorph:
But you, our difficult necessary one—we made room for ourselves through you in the only way we had. Even now, we are metabolizing you. Will you arrive whole with that softness you perform, or the correction you can't stop reaching for? Are you the guest still, or the furniture?


Because listen to yourself, singular plural, it is felt that there is repetition in you, about the use of this congregation of yours, whether you have made it a kind of private weather system, a shelter for your own unfinished sentences that you keep mouthing at us; or whether you have made it a tribunal dressed as a kitchen, a pulpit for the unpriested, with the parts of you that work either withdrawn into the voice you use alone, or rehearsing a posture of care that disciplines, administering warmth and rigor in alternation, claiming you come as no one in particular; or else refusing to hear yourself in our mouths, rife with tenderness misdirected, unreceptive to your own echo, carving out silences you call listening, dealing in the embrace that is the patriarch's.

kernel.governing_law: The speaker addresses a beloved community with the authority-paradox: teaching without domination, grammar without institution — and diagnoses that the community has reproduced the very hierarchies it fled, splitting into petty academies and anti-academies that mirror the imperial structure.
kernel.mutated_relation: The community addresses its speaker with the dependency-paradox: receiving without submission, need without hierarchy — and diagnoses that the speaker has reproduced the very intimacy they claim, splitting into petty tenderness and petty discipline that mirror the congregant's own fracture.
